error_codes.summary: An ID or command name does not exist
The target is locked (a locked track, or soft-locked by another transaction)
Stale revision, reused request_id, or a state the request cannot be applied to
A param failed schema or semantic validation; the error carries a JSON Pointer
The caller's credential lacks the scope the command needs
A valid request this version cannot do
A bug or panic in the engine

input_schema.description:
Reads one item: the `timeline.get` item summary plus its track, source, audio and visual
properties. `fields` limits the extra sections (`name`, `source`, `audio`, `visual`).

fields.description: Sections to include: any of `name`, `source`, `audio`, `visual` (default all).

input_schema.title: ItemGet

queries.name: item.get

attached_to.description: The item this one is attached to (it follows that parent), if any.

oneOf.description: A keyed (animated) value: keys sorted by strictly increasing t (keyframes §3).

items.description: A key: a value at an item-relative time (flicks), and the easing of the segment to the next key (keyframes §3.1).

interp.description:
How the segment that starts at a key moves to the next key (keyframes §4). It is a closed
set: a new kind is a schema change.

Every kind except `hold` is an easing `p(u)` with `p(0) = 0` and `p(u) → 1` as `u → 1`,
fed into one lerp per value type (§5). On the wire it is an object tagged by `kind`
(`{"kind": "bezier", "x1": 0.42, "y1": 0, "x2": 0.58, "y2": 1, "preset": "ease_in_out"}`)
with exactly its fields; construction checks their ranges (KF-5) and the hint (KF-7).

oneOf.description: The key's value until the next key, then a jump (§4.2).

A CSS-style cubic Bézier from (0, 0) to (1, 1), normalized to the segment (§4.4).
(`x1`, `y1`) shapes the speed leaving the key, (`x2`, `y2`) the speed arriving at the
next one.

preset.description:
The preset these numbers came from, a hint for the UI and agents (§4.6). Never read
by evaluation.

x1.description: First control point, time axis, in `[0, 1]`.

x2.description: Second control point, time axis, in `[0, 1]`.

y1.description: First control point, progress axis, in `[−10, 10]` (beyond `[0, 1]` overshoots).

y2.description: Second control point, progress axis, in `[−10, 10]`.

oneOf.description:
A damped spring in real seconds, released from rest, plus a residual that lands it
exactly on the next key (§4.5).

bounce.description: A hard stop at the target: the motion reflects instead of passing it.

preset.description: The preset these numbers came from (§4.6). Never read by evaluation.

t.description: Item-relative time in flicks (1/705600000 s); 0 is the item's first frame.

item.description: The same projection `timeline.get` returns at depth 2.

enabled.description: Whether the item is rendered and heard.

start.description: Timeline position of the first frame.

linked.description: The other items of the linked group, if any.

items.description: A Item id: `^itm_[0-9a-f]{32}$`.

name.description: The display name, if it has one (unless `fields` leaves it out).

source.description: Media and source position (unless `fields` leaves it out).

source_in.description: Position in the media of the clip's first frame.

blend_mode.description: How the item combines with what is below.

crop.description: Edges of the source picture cut away.

bottom.description: Fraction removed from the bottom edge.
